learningObjective: Reason about what information a TorchInductor IR dump reveals and what it does not, and how to use it for debugging compilation issues.

canonicalClaims.claim: TorchInductor debug dumps expose the post-AOTAutograd FX graph, scheduler fusion decisions, and generated Triton (CUDA) / C++ (CPU) code, enabling diagnosis of missing fusions, unexpected kernel launches, and fallback paths.
nonImplications: Does not imply IR dumps replace runtime profiling.
Does not imply the dumps expose PTX/SASS or ONNX serialization.

misconceptions.whyWrong: The dumps stop at the Triton (or C++) source level; PTX/SASS analysis uses ptxas -v and Nsight Compute.
The dumps are Inductor's internal format; ONNX export is a separate path.
They contain graph structure and generated code; weights are separate.

misconceptions.claim: IR dumps automatically show autotuning history.
